# Ace Data Cloud — Full Documentation

> Unified AI API platform — One API key for 100+ AI services including LLM chat, image generation, video generation, music creation, web search, and more.

Ace Data Cloud provides developer-friendly REST APIs for AI services that are otherwise hard to access programmatically. All APIs use Bearer token authentication, return JSON responses, and have OpenAPI specifications. The platform supports OpenAI-compatible interfaces, meaning you can use the official OpenAI Python/JavaScript SDK to access Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, and 50+ other models by simply changing the base URL. The platform also offers 11 MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers published on PyPI for seamless AI agent integration with Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, and other MCP-compatible clients.

**Base URL:** `https://api.acedata.cloud`
**Authentication:** Bearer token in Authorization header
**Documentation:** https://docs.acedata.cloud
**Platform:** https://platform.acedata.cloud

---

## Getting Started

### Quick Start
1. Register at https://platform.acedata.cloud
2. Subscribe to a service (e.g., Claude, Midjourney, Suno)
3. Create API credentials (Bearer token)
4. Make your first API call

### Authentication
All API requests require a Bearer token:
```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN
```
Each token is bound to a specific service subscription. Rate limits vary by service.

Full guide: https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/authentication

---

## AI Chat APIs (OpenAI-Compatible)

All chat APIs support the OpenAI `/v1/chat/completions` endpoint format. Use the official `openai` Python or JavaScript SDK by setting `base_url="https://api.acedata.cloud"`.

### Claude API
- **Models:** claude-sonnet-4-20250514, claude-3.5-sonnet, claude-3.5-haiku, claude-3-opus
- **Features:** Chat completions, streaming, tool use, vision (image input), extended thinking
- **Guide:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/claude/claude_chat_completions
- **API Reference:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/api-reference/claude/claude-chat-completions
- **Tutorial (Python):** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/tutorials/claude/python

### OpenAI API
- **Models:** gpt-4.1, gpt-4.1-mini, gpt-4.1-nano, gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, o3, o3-mini, o4-mini
- **Features:** Chat completions, streaming, tool use, vision, image generation, embeddings
- **Guide:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/openai/openai_chat_completions
- **API Reference:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/api-reference/openai/openai-chat-completions

### Gemini API
- **Models:** gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.0-flash, gemini-1.5-pro
- **Features:** Chat completions, streaming, vision, extended thinking
- **Guide:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/gemini/gemini_chat_completions

### DeepSeek API
- **Models:** deepseek-r1, deepseek-v3, deepseek-chat, deepseek-reasoner
- **Features:** Chat completions, streaming, reasoning, coding
- **Guide:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/deepseek/deepseek_chat_completions

### Grok API
- **Models:** grok-3, grok-3-mini, grok-2
- **Features:** Chat completions, streaming, vision
- **Guide:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/grok/grok_chat_completions

### Kimi API
- **Models:** kimi-latest, moonshot-v1-8k, moonshot-v1-32k, moonshot-v1-128k
- **Features:** Chat completions, streaming, long context
- **Guide:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/kimi/kimi_chat_completions

## AI Image APIs

### Midjourney API
- **Features:** Text-to-image (imagine), image editing (vary, upscale, pan, zoom), describe, seed, translate, video
- **Async:** Submit task → poll for results
- **Guide:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/midjourney/midjourney_imagine
- **Tutorial:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/tutorials/midjourney/python

### Flux API
- **Models:** flux-1.1-pro-ultra, flux-1.1-pro, flux-1-pro, flux-1-dev, flux-1-schnell, flux-1-canny
- **Features:** Text-to-image with multiple quality/speed options
- **Guide:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/flux/flux_images

### Seedream API (ByteDance)
- **Features:** Text-to-image generation and image editing
- **Guide:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/seedream/seedream_images

### Nano Banana API
- **Features:** Image generation, virtual try-on (clothing/accessories)
- **Guide:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/nano-banana/nanobanana_images

### QR Art API
- **Features:** Generate artistic AI QR codes combining design with functionality
- **Guide:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/qrart/qrart_generate

### Face API
- **Features:** Face swap, beautify, cartoon, detect, age change, gender change, liveness detection
- **Guide:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/face-change/face_swap

### Headshots API (DrawAI)
- **Features:** AI professional headshot generation from photo
- **Guide:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/drawai/headshots_generation

---

## AI Video APIs

All video APIs use async processing: submit a generation task, then poll for results.

### Sora API (OpenAI)
- **Features:** Text-to-video, image-to-video
- **Guide:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/sora/sora_videos
- **Tutorial:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/tutorials/sora/python

### Veo API (Google)
- **Features:** Text-to-video, image-to-video, high-quality cinematic output
- **Guide:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/veo/veo_videos

### Luma Dream Machine API
- **Features:** Text-to-video, image-to-video
- **Guide:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/luma/luma_videos

### Kling API (Kuaishou)
- **Features:** Text-to-video, image-to-video, motion brush
- **Guide:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/kling/kling_videos

### Hailuo API (MiniMax)
- **Features:** Text-to-video, image-to-video
- **Guide:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/hailuo/hailuo_videos

### Seedance API (ByteDance)
- **Features:** Text-to-video, image-to-video
- **Guide:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/seedance/seedance_videos

### Wan API (Tongyi Wanxiang)
- **Features:** Text-to-video, image-to-video
- **Guide:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/wan/wan_videos

## AI Audio APIs

### Suno API
- **Features:** Text-to-music generation, custom lyrics, song extension, covers, stems separation, persona, style control, timing, WAV/MP4 export
- **Guide:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/suno/suno_audios
- **Tutorial:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/tutorials/suno/python

### Fish Audio API
- **Features:** Text-to-speech with voice cloning, multiple voices and languages
- **Guide:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/fish/fish_audios

### Producer API
- **Features:** AI music production, lyrics generation, stem separation, video generation
- **Guide:** https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/producer/producer_audios

- **Features:** Translate JSON content into any language

## MCP Servers

Model Context Protocol servers for AI agent integration. Install via pip. Compatible with Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, and any MCP-compatible client.

| Server | PyPI Package | Description |
|--------|-------------|-------------|
| [SunoMCP](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/mcp/suno) | mcp-suno | AI music generation (Suno) |
| [MidjourneyMCP](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/mcp/midjourney) | mcp-midjourney | AI image generation (Midjourney) |
| [SerpMCP](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/mcp/serp) | mcp-serp | Google SERP search |
| [LumaMCP](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/mcp/luma) | mcp-luma | AI video (Luma Dream Machine) |
| [SoraMCP](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/mcp/sora) | mcp-sora | AI video (OpenAI Sora) |
| [VeoMCP](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/mcp/veo) | mcp-veo | AI video (Google Veo) |
| [FluxMCP](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/mcp/flux) | mcp-flux | AI image (Flux) |
| [SeedreamMCP](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/mcp/seedream) | mcp-seedream | AI image (Seedream) |
| [SeedanceMCP](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/mcp/seedance) | mcp-seedance | AI video (Seedance) |
| [NanoBananaMCP](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/mcp/nanobanana) | mcp-nanobanana | AI image (Gemini-based) |
| [ShortURLMCP](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/mcp/shorturl) | mcp-shorturl | URL shortening |

All servers: https://github.com/AceDataCloud — MIT licensed, open source.

## Pricing

- **Pay-as-you-go:** No monthly fees, pay only for what you use
- **Free tier:** Available for testing
- **Payment methods:** Stripe (USD), Alipay (CNY), WeChat Pay (CNY), X402 crypto protocol (USDC on Base/Solana)
- **Pricing page:** https://platform.acedata.cloud (see individual service pricing)
